title: Magician ability suite
summary: Immediately after advancement, Klein identifies the Magician's core combat and survival toolkit, including Damage Transfer, Flaming Jump, Air Bullets, Paper Figurine Substitute, Flame Controlling and Illusion Creation.

title: Channels Increase
summary: Alger secures a channel for Deep-sea Naga hair, leaving the Human-skinned Shadow characteristic as Klein's final major Faceless material bottleneck.

title: Bait
summary: The City of Silver uses Klein's Spirit World Plunderer true soul body as bait, kills the Bizarro Bane/Shapeshifter and secures its blood and forming ingredient for Klein's advancement chain.

title: Bizarro Sorcerer ability suite
summary: After becoming a demigod, Klein measures the qualitative jump in transformation, damage transfer, Flaming Jump, Air Bullets, Spirit Body Thread control, marionette power-sharing and position swapping.
